title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: NOURISH (Nature-Based Opportunities Underpinning Resilient and Sustainable Households) aims to reduce poverty and hunger in vulnerable households and communities in Karamoja, Uganda. The project aims to benefit 22,450 women, men, girls and boys through improved sustainable livelihoods, through nutrition sensitive climate smart approaches; increased consumption of nutritious and safe diets; strengthened Disaster Risk Reduction strategies with appropriate climate mitigation and adaptation activities and increased social and cultural empowerment for women and girls. NOURISH targets the poorest households, prioritising those that are female headed, or have a pregnant woman or young child, or are led by a person with a disability. Key activities include Climate Smart Agriculture; savings groups and microfinance; promoting household nutrition; prevention of post-harvest losses; disaster preparedness and management; social accountability around protection of the environment; natural resource management and climate adaptation; addressing harmful attitudes, norms, values and practices around gender equity and social inclusion.OBJECTIVES: Increased and diverse sources of income in target households particularly for female headed households/vulnerable householdsOUTCOMES: Improved and sustainable livelihoods, particularly for vulnerable/ female headed households, through nutrition sensitive climate smart approaches
